title: 1 Enoch 80 — The oracle of cosmic disorder in the days of the sinners

translation.sourceText: 1 Enoch Astronomical Book (Book of the Luminaries / Sefer ha-Mazzalot) — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Aramaic DSS 4Q208-4Q211, OLDEST surviving Enoch material late 3rd c. BCE, primary where preserved; Ge'ez Charles 1912 PD + Knibb 1978 fallback). No Greek witness — Akhmim Panopolitanus covers chs 1-32 only.

paragraphs.text: ወበጊዜሁ፡ ይቤለኒ፡ ኦሪኤል፡ መልአክ፡ ናሁ፡ አርአይኩከ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወከሠትኩ፡ ለከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ከመ፡ ትርአይ፡ ዘንተ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወዘንተ፡ ወርኀ፡ ወመራኅያኒሆሙ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ሰማይ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘያስተራኩም፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ወመንግሥቶሙ፡ ወጊዜሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-gizēhu yəbēlanī ʾUrʾēl malʾak nāhu ʾarʾayku-ka Henok kwəlo wa-kaśatku la-ka kwəlo kama tərʾay zanta ḍaḥay wa-zanta warḫa wa-marāḫəyānihomu la-kawākəbt samāy wa-kwəlo zayāstarākum kiyāhomu gəbromu wa-mangəśtomu wa-gizēhomu

i18n.en: And at that time Uriel the angel said to me: Behold, Enoch, I have shown you all, and I have disclosed all to you, that you might see this sun and this moon and the leaders of the stars of heaven, and all who order them — their works and their dominions and their times.

paragraphs.text: ወበመዋዕለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ዓመታት፡ ይሠራዕ፡ ወእክለ፡ ዘርዕ፡ ይሠቀል፡ በምድሮሙ፡ ወበግብሮሙ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ይሠቀል፡ ወአዝመተ፡ ምድር፡ ይትዐጽው፡ ወዘርእ፡ ዘዕለቶሙ፡ ኢይትከሥት፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድሮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-mawāʿəla ḫāṭəʾān ʿāmatāt yəśarrāʿ wa-ʾəkla zarʿ yəśaqqal ba-mədromu wa-ba-gəbromu wa-kwəlu lāʿla mədr yəśaqqal wa-ʾazmata mədr yətʿaḍḍəw wa-zarʾə za-ʿəlatomu ʾiyətkaśśat lāʿla mədromu

i18n.en: And in the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened, and the seed of grain shall be late in their lands and in their fields; and everything upon the earth shall be afflicted, and the rains of the earth shall be withheld, and the seed of their days shall not come up upon their lands.

paragraphs.commentary:
**THE COSMIC-DISORDER ORACLE — opening of the foundational Second-Temple-period cosmic-signs eschatological pericope.** 'In the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened.' This verse opens one of the foundational Second-Temple-period texts of the cosmic-signs eschatological tradition — the framework that runs through Joel 2:30-31 (Hebrew Bible substrate), Mt 24:29 + Mk 13:24-25 + Lk 21:25-26 (Synoptic Olivet Discourse), Rev 6:12-13 (sixth-seal opening), Sura 81:1-14 *al-Takwīr* (Qur'anic rolling-up-of-the-sun), and Sura 54:1 *inshiqāq al-qamar* (Qur'anic moon-splitting).

**The wickedness-of-humanity correlation.** A distinctive feature of the 1 En 80 framework is the explicit correlation between the cosmic-disorder and human-wickedness: the cosmic-bodies depart from their natural-cosmic-order *in the days of the sinners*. The cosmic-disorder is concurrent with — and in some sense caused by — the human-sinfulness of the end-times. The framework is one of the most-influential Second-Temple-period eschatological-cosmographic frameworks.

See central entry `cosmic-disorder-1-enoch-80-end-times-cross-corpus-joel-nt-revelation-qur-an` for the systematic treatment. The existing NT cosmic-signs cluster entry `cosmic-signs-cluster-joel-2-mark-13-acts-2-luke-21-rev-6-cross-corpus` is extended in this Editor pass to include the ENO-WOH-80 refIds.

paragraphs.text: ወይትዐጾ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘለፍሬ፡ ጽጌ፡ በላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወዕፅ፡ ይዕወር፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ወወይን፡ ይትዐጾ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ወብዙኅ፡ ዘርዕ፡ ይሰየብ፡ ወይትከሐድ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yətʿaḍḍo kwəlu zala-fərē ṣəgē ba-lāʿla mədr wa-ʿəḍ yəʿwər fərēhu wa-wayn yətʿaḍḍo fərēhu wa-bəzuḫ zarʾə yəsayyab wa-yətkaḥad

i18n.en: And every fruit-bearing blossom on the earth shall be withheld; the tree shall withhold its fruit, and the vine shall withhold its fruit; and much seed shall be sown but shall come to nothing.

paragraphs.text: ወወርኅ፡ ይትዌላጥ፡ ሕገጊሁ፡ ወኢይትከሠት፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-warḫ yətwēllāṭ ḥəgagihu wa-ʾiyətkaśśat baba gizēhu

i18n.en: And the moon shall change her laws and shall not appear in her appointed times.

paragraphs.commentary: **The moon-departing-from-her-order — direct cosmic-signs language.** This verse contains the direct cosmic-signs statement: the moon alters her order and does not appear in her appointed time. The framework parallels Mt 24:29 ('the moon shall not give her light' / *hē selēnē ou dōsei to phengos autēs*), Mk 13:24-25 (the same Markan formulation), Joel 2:31 ('the moon to blood' / *ha-yārēaḥ lĕ-dām*), and Sura 54:1 *inshiqāq al-qamar* (the moon-splitting). The 1 En 80 framework provides one of the OLDEST stratigraphic-layers of this entire cosmic-signs cluster, given the Aramaic-DSS dating of the Astronomical Book to the late 3rd c. BCE.

paragraphs.text: ወበእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይትከሠት፡ በሰማይ፡ ወይመጽእ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ድርቅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ድንኅ፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ሰማይ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለመንበረ፡ ከዋክብት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾəmāntu mawāʿəl yətkaśśat ba-samāy wa-yəmaṣṣəʾ ʿabəy dərq lāʿla dənḫ məśrāq samāy qədmēhu la-manbara kawākəbt

i18n.en: And in those days there shall appear in heaven a great drought upon the eastern horizon of heaven, before the station of the stars.

paragraphs.text: ወብዙኃን፡ መርሐ፡ ሐራ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ይስሕቱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ዘትእዛዝ፡ ወይትዌላጡ፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ ወግብሮሙ፡ ወኢይትከሠቱ፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡ ሎሙ፡ ዘሥርዕተ፡ ሎሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bəzuḫān marḥa ḥarā la-kawākəbt yəsḥətu śərʿata zatəʾəzāz wa-yətwēllāṭu fənotomu wa-gəbromu wa-ʾiyətkaśśatu baba gizēhomu lomu zaśərʿta lomu

i18n.en: And many chiefs of the host of the stars shall transgress the order of the command, and shall change their courses and their tasks, and shall not appear in their appointed times — the times prescribed for them.

paragraphs.commentary: **The stars transgressing their orbits — direct cosmic-signs language.** This verse contains the direct cosmic-signs statement: the stars transgress their orbits and shall not appear in their appointed times. The framework parallels Mt 24:29 (*hoi asteres pesountai apo tou ouranou* 'the stars shall fall from heaven'), Rev 6:13 (*hoi asteres tou ouranou epesan eis tēn gēn* 'the stars of heaven fell to the earth'), Rev 12:4 (the dragon's tail sweeping a third of the stars), and Isa 13:10 (the stars of the heavens not giving their light). The 1 En 80:6 'transgress the order of the command' framing extends the broader Second-Temple-Jewish fallen-stars / rebellious-luminary tradition (cross-corpus to 1 En 18:13-16 + 21:1-6 — the fallen stars in their place-of-judgement; Jude 6 + 2 Pet 2:4).

paragraphs.text: ወኵሉ፡ ሕገገ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ይትዐፀዉ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ወያስተዐሰዉ፡ መንፈሰ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ቤት፡ ይነብሩ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወያስሕቱ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወይትገበሩ፡ አማልክት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kwəlu ḥəgaga la-kawākəbt yətʿaḍḍəw lāʿla ḫāṭəʾān wa-yāstaʿassəw manfasa ʾəmənnehomu la-ʾəlla bēt yənabbəru ba-lāʿlēhomu wa-yāsḥətu kiyāhomu wa-yətgabbaru ʾamālekt

i18n.en: And all the laws of the stars shall be shut against the sinners; and they shall lead astray the minds of those who dwell upon the earth, and they shall be regarded by them as gods.

paragraphs.commentary: **Humans mistake the stars for gods — the primal idolatry-frame.** This verse names the cosmic-disorder's spiritual-consequence: the disordered-stars lead humanity astray, with humans worshipping the stars as gods. The framework is a Second-Temple-Jewish development of the primal-idolatry tradition: the host-of-heaven worship that the Hebrew Bible repeatedly denounces. Cross-corpus to Deut 4:19 ('lest you lift up your eyes to heaven, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the host of heaven, you be drawn away and bow down to them and serve them'), Jer 7:18 + 8:2 + 19:13 (the host-of-heaven idolatry under Judah's last kings), 2 Kings 23:5 (the *mazzālôt*-worshippers purged by Josiah's reform), Wisd 13:1-2 (the wise-of-the-Gentiles taking the cosmic-bodies for gods), and Acts 7:42-43 (Stephen's speech citing Amos 5:25-27 LXX on the worship of the host-of-heaven). The 1 En 80:7 cosmic-disorder + star-worship combination presents a developed-eschatological extension of the broader Hebrew-Bible host-of-heaven-worship tradition.

paragraphs.text: ወይብዝኅ፡ እኩይ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወመቅሠፍት፡ ይመጽእ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ለመጥፋዕተ፡ ኵሎሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbzəḫ ʾəkuy lāʿlēhomu wa-maqśaft yəmaṣṣəʾ lāʿlēhomu la-maṭfāʿta kwəlomu

i18n.en: And evil shall be multiplied upon them, and judgment shall come upon them, unto the destruction of them all.
